statutoryTitle: Reserve Bank of India (Note Refund) Rules, 2009 (Amended 2018)

denominationsUnder50.fullValue: Area of single largest undivided piece is not less than 50% of original banknote area.
denominationsUnder50.halfValue: No half value payable on denominations below ₹50.

denominations50AndAbove.fullValue: Area of single largest undivided piece is not less than 80% (75% for certain new series) of the total area.
denominations50AndAbove.halfValue: Area of single undivided piece is not less than 40% of the total area.
denominations50AndAbove.zeroValue: Area is less than 40% of the total area.

ruleSummary.commercialBankObligation: Under RBI Master Direction, all branches of commercial and cooperative banks are authorized and obligated to adjudicate and pay value for soiled and mutilated notes.
